T: Last of the V8 Interceptors. First of the snacks.
D: A highway patrol cop takes on a vicious bikie gang in a near-future Australia.
P: Serve the mains when Max and his family head off on their coastal holiday.
S: Thick chips tossed in chicken salt, with gravy for dipping

Thick-cut chips double fried at 140C then 190C, tossed in chicken salt, served in butcher's paper with gravy for dipping. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and fry at 140C, then 190C. Toss in chicken salt. Whisk 3 tbsp gravy powder into 375ml boiling water. Serve the chips in butcher's paper with gravy for dipping.
Pickling onions in sweet malt vinegar with chili, served with cheese and crackers
Pickling onions brined overnight, packed in hot spiced vinegar with sugar, chilli and peppercorns, pickled a week. Served with tasty cheese and crackers.
M: the family trip up the coast

Flathead fillets in crisp beer batter with thick chips, chicken salt, lemon and a punchy tartare, wrapped in paper and eaten by the water. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, fry at 140C for 7 minutes, then 190C for 3 minutes and toss with chicken salt. Whisk 200g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and salt with 300ml cold beer. Dust 4 flathead fillets in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until golden. Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped gherkins, capers, dill and lemon. Wrap in paper with lemon wedges.
Last of the V8s highway meat pie
Slow braised beef pie with a puff pastry lid, tomato sauce on top

Beef chuck braised in stock and Worcestershire for 2.5 hours, thickened, cooled, in shortcrust with a puff lid, baked at 200C for 30 minutes. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, add 500ml stock and 2 tbsp Worcestershire and braise 2.5 hours. Thicken and cool. Line 4 pie tins with shortcrust, fill, top with puff and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Sauce on top.
W: Vanilla ice cream in waffle cones with a hard chocolate shell
Vanilla ice cream scooped into waffle cones, drizzled with a hard chocolate shell of dark chocolate melted with coconut oil, which sets in seconds.
K: Chilled coffee and milk with vanilla ice cream and whipped cream
Strong coffee cooled, poured over ice with cold milk, a scoop of vanilla ice cream and whipped cream.

s.note: Thick chips tossed in chicken salt, with gravy for dipping
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and fry at 140C, then 190C. Toss in chicken salt. Whisk 3 tbsp gravy powder into 375ml boiling water. Serve the chips in butcher's paper with gravy for dipping.

s.note: Pickling onions in sweet malt vinegar with chili, served with cheese and crackers
s.how: Peel 500g pickling onions and soak in salted water overnight. Pack into a jar, then pour over 500ml malt vinegar boiled with 100g sugar, a chilli and 1 tsp peppercorns. Leave a week. Serve with 200g tasty cheese and crackers.

m.n: Last of the V8s highway meat pie
m.note: Slow braised beef pie with a puff pastry lid, tomato sauce on top
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, add 500ml stock and 2 tbsp Worcestershire and braise 2.5 hours. Thicken and cool. Line 4 pie tins with shortcrust, fill, top with puff and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Sauce on top.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream in waffle cones with a hard chocolate shell
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 2 tbsp coconut oil and cool slightly. Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 4 waffle cones. Drizzle over the chocolate so it sets hard in seconds. Eat it before it drips.

d.note: Chilled coffee and milk with vanilla ice cream and whipped cream
d.how: Brew 60g coffee with 500ml water and chill. Pour over ice in four tall glasses with 600ml cold milk. Add a scoop of vanilla ice cream and a swirl of 150ml whipped cream to each.
